title: Azure Compute Services
description: Explore Azure compute options including Virtual Machines, App Service, Functions, AKS, and Container Apps. Learn which service fits which workload.
longDescription: This module introduces the main compute services in Azure. You will learn how to choose between infrastructure-as-a-service, platform-as-a-service, and serverless options, and when to use containers with AKS or Container Apps.
whatYouLearn: Understand what Azure Virtual Machines are and how to pick the right size
Use availability sets to keep VMs running during maintenance
Create a basic VM using Azure CLI
Explain App Service plans, deployment slots, and scaling
Deploy a web app using a simple CLI command
Describe serverless computing, triggers, and bindings
Write a simple Azure Function in C#
Compare AKS and Container Apps for container workloads
